questions: Did the patient lose consciousness during or immediately after the fall?
Did the patient have any warning symptoms (lightheadedness, dizziness, visual changes, weakness) immediately before the fall?
Has the patient had similar falls before?
Does the patient have any history of cardiovascular disease, stroke, or Parkinson's disease?
Is the patient currently on any antihypertensive or cardiac medications?
Were the warning symptoms specifically dizziness, lightheadedness, or a spinning sensation (vertigo)?

Do you have any neck pain, or do the symptoms occur when turning your head?
Do the falls/symptoms specifically happen when you first stand up from sitting or lying down (orthostatic)?
Do the falls/symptoms happen while you are walking (suggesting possible freezing or gait disorder)?
